messages.text: Kane becomes first English winner of Ballon d'Or in 25 years

metadata.summary: Harry Kane has become the first English winner of the Ballon d'Or in 25 years after being honoured at a ceremony in London.
metadata.content: Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or: Bayern Munich striker becomes first English winner of award in 25 years | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or: Bayern Munich striker becomes first English winner of award in 25 years Harry Kane wins 2026 Ballon d'Or at London ceremony; Bayern Munich striker becomes first English winner of award in 25 years; England captain hit 73 goals for club and country last season; ex-Tottenham forward beat Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe and Barcelona winger Lamine Yamal to prize Tuesday 27 October 2026 07:36, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Harry Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or as the Bayern Munich striker becomes the first English winner of the award in 25 years Harry Kane has become the first English winner of the Ballon d'Or in 25 years after being honoured at a ceremony in London. Michael Owen was the last player from England to receive the prestigious individual accolade in 2001, but Kane's incredible 73-goal haul last season for club and country earned him the award from French magazine France Football. Bayern Munich forward Kane was a popular winner in the capital and has followed in the footsteps of Sir Stanley Matthews, Sir Bobby Charlton, Kevin Keegan and Owen as a Ballon d'Or winner from England. metadata.summary: Manchester United's players are set to return to training at Carrington on Tuesday - but it is still uncertain whether Michael Carrick will be in charge.
metadata.content: Manchester United: Players to return to training on Tuesday but uncertain if Michael Carrick will be in charge | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Manchester United: Players to return to training on Tuesday but uncertain if Michael Carrick will be in charge Man Utd beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth at Old Trafford to heap the pressure on head coach Michael Carrick; captain Bruno Fernandes was dropped and United are eight games without a win; players set to return to training on Tuesday after Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox met for talks on Monday Monday 26 October 2026 20:13, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports' Danyal Khan explains what happened at Manchester United's Carrington training ground on Monday as Michael Carrick's future remains in doubt Manchester United's players are set to return to training at Carrington on Tuesday - but it is still uncertain whether Michael Carrick will be in charge. United head coach Carrick was at Carrington on Monday to watch the club's U21s take on Hull in a behind-closed-doors game. messages.text: Fearnley retires injured to give Fery victory at Vienna Open

metadata.summary: Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury after losing 5-1 in the first set against Arthur Fery to give his fellow countryman a place in the second round at the Vienna Open.
metadata.content: Jacob Fearnley retires hurt against Arthur Fery at Vienna Open as Harriet Dart extends winning run | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Jacob Fearnley retires hurt against Arthur Fery at Vienna Open as Harriet Dart extends winning run Arthur Fery is into the second round of the Vienna Open after fellow Brit Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury in the first set; Harriet Dart has won her third successive match at the Guangzhou Open; watch WTA and ATP Tours live on Sky Sports Monday 26 October 2026 17:30, UK Image: Arthur Fery is into the second round at the Vienna Open Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury after losing 5-1 in the first set against Arthur Fery to give his fellow countryman a place in the second round at the Vienna Open. Fearnley was broken by Fery in just his second service game, with the British No 1 winning the next two games on the bounce and looking set to consign his opponent to a comprehensive first-set loss. Fearnley, though, then put a stop to the contest, shaking the umpire's hand and retiring with an unspecified injury, allowing Fery safe passage to the next stage of the competition. messages.text: Jay-Z picks himself to headline Super Bowl half-time show in LA

metadata.summary: Jay-Z has announced himself as the headline act at the Super Bowl LXI half-time show in Los Angeles.
metadata.content: Super Bowl 2027: Jay-Z to headline Super Bowl LXI half-time show at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Super Bowl 2027: Jay-Z to headline Super Bowl LXI half-time show at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles Jay-Z picks himself to headline the Super Bowl LXI half-time show on February 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California; the 25-time Grammy Award-winning rapper follows on from the likes of Kendrick Lamar, Michael Jackson, Coldplay and Rihanna in leading the NFL's showpiece entertainment Tuesday 27 October 2026 07:00, UK Image: Jay-Z will perform at the half-time show of Super Bowl LXI in Los Angeles Jay-Z has announced himself as the headline act at the Super Bowl LXI half-time show in Los Angeles. The rapper's Roc Nation entertainment company has been in partnership with the NFL to produce the Super Bowl half-time show since 2019 - seven years on, it is his turn. The Super Bowl heads to SoFi Stadium, home of the Los Angeles Rams and Chargers, on Sunday February 14, live on Sky Sports NFL. "From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey," stated Jay-Z. "Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world's biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true." This year has marked a celebration of "JAY-Z 30" three decades on from his debut album Reasonable Doubt, resulting in attendance records at sold-out concerts at Yankee Stadium as well as in London, Paris and Los Angeles.
